avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce hepatic metabolism and reduce vigabatrin efficacy; increases seizure risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concomitant use; consult prescriber before initiating

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate CNS depression; high-dose magnesium may affect drug absorption
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased sedation; separate dosing by 2 hours

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May theoretically interact with GABA metabolism; high doses may affect seizure threshold
caution_supplements.action: Monitor; maintain consistent B6 intake; avoid megadosing

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Potentiates CNS depression and may lower seizure threshold
caution_foods.action: Minimize or avoid alcohol consumption; counsel on increased drowsiness/dizziness risk

monitoring_notes: Vigabatrin is minimally metabolized enzymatically and has low food/supplement interaction potential. Primary concern is CNS depression risk and seizure threshold modification with depressants. Monitor renal function as vigabatrin is renally eliminated.
